verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
In troubled times You will hide me
In troubled times You will hide me there
In the secret place You will hide me
In the secret place You will hide me there

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
And You shall set me high upon a rock
And You shall set me high upon a rock
Upon a rock

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And my head shall be lifted up
Above my enemies
And I will sing, I will sing to You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
My heart will sing, praise the Lord
My heart will sing praise
